initial_plan.can_answer: partly — compares the share of crash records with reported injury or death by time of day but cannot estimate risk per traveler or amount of travel
initial_plan.metric: Share of eligible crash records with at least one person injured or killed
initial_plan.denominator: Crash records with nonmissing number_of_persons_injured and number_of_persons_killed, within each time group
initial_plan.population: All crash records in the file with a crash_date; records with either outcome count missing are ineligible for this share
initial_plan.filters: Night = 20:00–05:59; daytime = 06:00–19:59; missing/unclassifiable crash_time is a separate group; no year filter
initial_plan.years: Every calendar year represented in the file

data_check.meaning_and_decisions: All 2,269,187 records have a crash_date. There are no crash_date values at the checked possible sentinels 1900-01-01, 1970-01-01, or 2000-01-01, and no unknown-text or unparseable date values (the field is typed DATE). The observed period is 2012-07-01 through 2026-06-11, so 2012 and 2026 are partial by observed date range; retain all years and disclose the partial endpoints. There are 0 missing, unknown-text, or unparseable crash_time values, so the missing/unclassifiable group has no rows. The 24,566 00:00:00 timestamps could be valid midnight times or defaults; retain them in the night group and disclose. number_of_persons_injured is missing on 18 rows and number_of_persons_killed on 8,913 rows; 8,919 distinct rows lack one or both. Exclude those 8,919 rows from both numerator and denominator because their injury/death status cannot be determined completely.

final_plan.can_answer: partly — compares recorded injury-or-death crash shares by time but cannot establish relative danger per traveler or amount of travel
final_plan.metric: Share of eligible crash records with at least one person injured or killed, calculated as 100 × records where number_of_persons_injured + number_of_persons_killed ≥ 1 divided by eligible records
final_plan.denominator: Within each time group, crash records with both number_of_persons_injured and number_of_persons_killed present
final_plan.population: Crash records with a crash_date over 2012-07-01 through 2026-06-11; the share uses only records with both injury and death counts present
final_plan.filters: Night = 20:00–05:59; daytime = 06:00–19:59; include missing/unclassifiable time as a separate group if present; exclude records missing either outcome count from numerator and denominator; no crash or location filters
final_plan.years: All represented years, 2012–2026, including partial 2012 and 2026
final_plan.grouping: Night versus daytime; missing/unclassifiable time is a separate group if present
final_plan.limitations: There are no missing dates, no date values at the checked possible sentinels 1900-01-01, 1970-01-01, or 2000-01-01, and no unknown-text or unparseable date/time values. Keep the 24,566 00:00:00 timestamps in the night group but flag that this exact-time pileup may include default times. Exclude 8,919 records (0.39% of records with dates) from both numerator and denominator because at least one of the two outcome counts is missing (injured missing: 18; killed missing: 8,913). The date span includes partial 2012 and 2026. The measure is the share among crash records, not risk per traveler; no travel-exposure denominator is available.
